QSC Automotive is an independent specialist workshop. It is not an authorized dealer or factory-certified service center for any vehicle manufacturer, and brand names are used only to describe the vehicles serviced.

Why organize service by marque?

Because every marque carries its own engineering personality: Mercedes air suspension has its failure patterns, BMW dual-clutch gearboxes their service needs, Range Rover aluminium bodies their repair rules, Ferrari colors their matching sensitivities. The brand page gathers the essence of how we work with your marque — the services its cars actually ask for, the workshop responsible for each job, and the direct booking path — instead of leaving you to find it scattered.

You will notice the pages' frankness: where our depth is real we say so, and where the manufacturer is the right answer — as for certain Bugatti and Pagani work — we say that too. The trust built by honesty on one page serves you across the whole car.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is QSC an authorized service center for these brands?

No — and the site says so plainly wherever brands appear. QSC is an independent specialist; brand names describe the vehicles serviced, and no factory affiliation, certification or endorsement is claimed.

My brand is not listed. Can you still help?

Possibly — the listed sixteen are the marques QSC focuses on, but related premium vehicles are assessed case by case. Call with your model and the workshop gives you a straight answer.

Does QSC service both old and new models of these brands?

Model coverage varies by generation and system. The brand pages describe the typical scope; for any specific vehicle, the assessment visit is where capability is confirmed honestly — before any commitment.
